description: How a committed reorder of a TmSortableList was performed. A host that has to announce, log or undo the change differently per input method reads this instead of guessing from the delta.

members.name: Pointer
members.description: The shared pointer drag: mouse, pen, or a touch long-press. Reported once per released gesture by the module, never while the pointer is still moving.

members.name: Keyboard
members.description: A keyboard move: the grab → arrows → drop sequence, or the Alt+arrow shortcut that commits one step without grabbing.

members.name: Menu
members.description: The per-row move menu — the tap and mouse alternative to dragging (WCAG 2.5.7). A deliberate command, so a host may treat it as one.
